description: This Java class is a global exception handler for a Spring Boot REST API. It uses annotations to handle specific exceptions such as resource not found, validation errors, and generic exceptions, returning structured JSON error responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A centralized REST controller advice class handling various exceptions globally across the application.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles ResourceNotFoundException by returning a 404 NOT FOUND response with error details.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors from MethodArgumentNotValidException and returns a 400 BAD REQUEST with validation details.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles generic exceptions, returning a 500 INTERNAL SERVER ERROR response.

methods.name: baseBody
methods.description: Creates a standard response body containing timestamp, status, error, and message.
